ios.desc:
Outcry is an AI mentor for activists, organizers, and anyone trying to change something bigger than themselves. Ask it how to plan a march, win a union drive, write a rally speech, escalate a campaign, or understand why a movement stalled — and get answers grounded in two centuries of movement history and strategy.

Created by Micah Bornfree, PhD — co-creator of Occupy Wall Street and author of THE END OF PROTEST — Outcry thinks like a senior organizer, not a corporate chatbot.

WHAT ORGANIZERS USE IT FOR
• Campaign strategy: direct actions, marches, escalation timelines, power mapping
• Writing: rally speeches, coalition letters, funder pitches, press releases
• Movement theory: Sharp, Alinsky, Turchin, the Combahee River Collective, and the tactics that actually worked
• Tactical problem-solving: messaging, media, fundraising, security culture, burnout
• Long strategic dialogue: many organizers run 50–100+ message conversations on a single campaign

HOW IT WORKS
1. Open Outcry and start talking. No sign-up needed to begin.
2. Choose your theory of change — the slider tunes the advice from institutional to insurrectionary.
3. Sign in with Apple to keep your conversations and continue them on the web at outcryai.com.

WHO IT'S FOR
Faith leaders planning marches. Labor organizers preparing steward trainings. Mutual aid facilitators rethinking their approach. Students running their first campaign. First-time activists trying to understand how change actually happens.

PLANS
Outcry is free to start, with a daily limit. Outcry Basic, Plus and Pro unlock more conversations, longer memory, and file uploads. Subscriptions renew monthly or yearly, are charged to your Apple ID, and can be cancelled any time in Settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.outcryai.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.outcryai.com/privacy/app

WHO BUILT IT
Outcry is made by Micah Bornfree — co-creator of Occupy Wall Street, author of THE END OF PROTEST, and longtime activist educator.
